
This document looks at the distribution of Habitat Suitability Index (HSI) for a sample of AquaX species.

```{r}
# Load functions for processing AquaX data
source(here( "common_fxns.R"))
```

## Prep AquaX data
We'll be working with a sample of species

```{r}
# read in meta data on the aquax species
load("/home/shares/data-aquax/META_02122025.Rdata")
```

```{r}
meta_clean <- META %>% 
  mutate(worms_name = tolower(ScientificName)) %>% 
  select(!ScientificName) %>% 
  # simplify for now for easier viewing
  select(AphiaID, SPID, worms_name, GROUP, NR_CR, range_pixels, SDM)
```

```{r}
spp_fs <- list.files('/home/shares/data-aquax/SDM',
                     full.names = TRUE)

df <- data.frame(f = spp_fs) %>%
    mutate(fsize = file.size(f),
           aphiaid = str_extract(basename(f), '[0-9]+') %>% as.integer()) %>%
    left_join(META, by = c('aphiaid' = 'AphiaID'))
```

```{r}
df_coastal <- df %>% 
    filter(Coastal == 1)

aphiaid_coastal <- df_coastal$aphiaid

df_noncoastal <- df %>% 
    filter(!aphiaid %in% aphiaid_coastal)
```

```{r}
test_f <- read_parquet("/home/shares/data-aquax/SDM/FINAL_EMSDM_EMMEAN_SP_1017389.parquet")
```

## Find pixel by pixel new and lost species within EEZs
Here, output is pixel by pixel. A species can be new or lost to a pixel even if it already present/absent in that EEZ.

# Test - all species 

```{r}
set.seed(123)
test_spp_100 <- slice_sample(df, n = 100)
files_100 <- test_spp_100$f
aphiaid_100 <- test_spp_100$aphiaid
```

```{r}
get_hsi <- function(id, df, scenario, n_threads = 1) {
    spp_filter <- df %>% filter(aphiaid == id)
  
  if (nrow(spp_filter) == 0) {
    warning("No rows found for aphiaid: ", id)
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Create database connection
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())

  # Ensure connection is closed 
  on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  # Cap threads so that function doesn't overscribe and hang
  DBI::dbExecute(con, paste0("PRAGMA threads = ", n_threads, ";"))

  query_str <- paste0("SELECT ROUND(Cutoff, 3) AS Cutoff,", paste(scenario, collapse = ", "), 
    " FROM read_parquet('", spp_filter$f, "')")

 # Run query and filter for scenario pixels above cutoff threshold

    spp_df <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, query_str) 

  # Set option for if there are no pixels above the cutoff threshold
    if (nrow(spp_df) == 0) {
        warning("No pixels above cutoff threshold for aphiaid: ", id)
      # Return 0 to track loss species
        return(data.frame(x = NA, y = NA, binary = 0, s = scenario))
    } else {
  
  # Return the pixels above the cutoff to be summarized into LC count  
  spp_df_clean <- spp_df %>% 
    mutate(s = scenario)

  return(spp_df_clean)
}}
```

```{r}
hsi_test <- lapply(aphiaid_100, FUN = get_hsi, df = test_spp_100, scenario = "Current")
```

```{r}
hsi_df_clean <- bind_rows(hsi_test) %>% 
    filter(round(Current, 3) > 0) 
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(data = hsi_df_clean, aes(x = Current), bins = 25) +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Habitat Suitability Index (HSI): 1 to 1000",
         x = "Habitat Suitability Index (HSI)",
         y = "Count of Pixels") +
    theme_minimal()
```

## Get a sample from coastal species 

```{r}
set.seed(123)
coastal_spp_100 <- slice_sample(df_coastal, n = 100)
coastal_files_100 <- coastal_spp_100$f
coastal_aphiaid_100 <- coastal_spp_100$aphiaid
```

```{r}
coastal_hsi_test <- lapply(coastal_aphiaid_100, FUN = get_hsi, df = coastal_spp_100, scenario = "Current")
```

```{r}
coastal_hsi_df_clean <- bind_rows(coastal_hsi_test) %>% 
    filter(round(Current, 3) > 0) 
```


```{r}
ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(data = coastal_hsi_df_clean, aes(x = Current), bins = 25) +
    labs(title = "Coastal Distribution of Habitat Suitability Index (HSI): 1 to 1000",
         x = "Habitat Suitability Index (HSI)",
         y = "Count of Pixels") +
    theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
noncoastal_spp_100 <- slice_sample(df_noncoastal, n = 100)
noncoastal_files_100 <- noncoastal_spp_100$f
noncoastal_aphiaid_100 <- noncoastal_spp_100$aphiaid
```

```{r}
noncoastal_hsi_test <- lapply(noncoastal_aphiaid_100, FUN = get_hsi, df = noncoastal_spp_100, scenario = "Current")
```


```{r}
noncoastal_hsi_df_clean <- bind_rows(noncoastal_hsi_test) %>% 
    filter(round(Current, 3) > 0) 
```


```{r}
ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(data = noncoastal_hsi_df_clean, aes(x = Current), bins = 30, fill = "aquamarine", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_histogram(data = coastal_hsi_df_clean, aes(x = Current), bins = 30, fill = "coral", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(coastal_hsi_df_clean$Cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "coral") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(coastal_hsi_df_clean$Current), color = "coral") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(noncoastal_hsi_df_clean$Current), color = "aquamarine") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean(noncoastal_hsi_df_clean$Cutoff), linetype = "dashed", color = "aquamarine") +
    labs(title = "Distribution of Habitat Suitability Index (HSI): 1 to 1000",
         x = "Habitat Suitability Index (HSI)",
         y = "Count of Pixels") +
    theme_minimal()
```
